category_name: On the wedding night or when buying an animal
title: On the wedding night or when buying an animal - Hisn al-Muslim 80
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā 'alayh, wa a'ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā jabaltahā 'alayh
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that You have made her inclined towards, and I seek refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that You have made her inclined towards.
reference: Abu Dawud 2/248, Ibn Majah 1/617, Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/324
